headlines.title: Nvidia's Colette Kress confronts key questions in first earnings report since Jensen Huang's exit
headlines.summary: This is the tape event of the week — Nvidia earnings with a brand-new interim CEO at the helm, less than a week after a $500 billion market-cap implosion. The whole AI trade is riding on this print: NVDA, AMD, SMCI, the data center REITs, every ETF with 'AI' in the name. If Kress stumbles on the call, the selling won't stop at the semiconductor aisle.

headlines.title: China confirms Xi-Trump-Putin historic summit. What will be on the agenda?
headlines.summary: A three-way summit between the world's biggest nuclear powers — covering Ukraine, the Middle East, trade and nukes — is the kind of headline that moves every asset class simultaneously. Defense names, energy, emerging markets, the dollar, and the long bond all have a stake in whatever comes out of this room. Markets hate uncertainty, but they love a ceasefire rumor.

headlines.title: Anthropic Holds the Key to the Future of the AI Trade
headlines.summary: Anthropic's IPO pricing Wednesday and debut Thursday is the first major AI pure-play to hit the public market, and the Street is watching the bid like a hawk — it's a real-time referendum on whether the AI capital cycle still has legs after the Nvidia mess. A weak open torches sentiment across the whole AI complex; a strong one gives the bulls their narrative back. GOOG and AMZN, both deep investors in Anthropic, have skin in this game too.
